name: First and last frame (Wan 2.2 Fun Inpaint)
description: Makes a Wan 2.2 video that starts at one frame and ends at another. Wan 2.2 TI2V can't take a last frame, so this runs Wan 2.2 Fun Inpaint 5B instead (wan2.2_fun_inpaint_5B_bf16.safetensors in diffusion_models, from Comfy-Org/Wan_2.2_ComfyUI_Repackaged on Hugging Face) with the workflow's text encoder, VAE and sampler settings. The workflow's own model and its LoRAs aren't used in this mode.
